sources.title: 2026 NFL rulebook
sources.finding: The page labels itself “2026 NFL RULEBOOK” and links the official PDF.
sources.limitation: Rules and scoring context only; not sportsbook settlement rules.

sources.title: Metric glossary
sources.finding: Time to Throw excludes sacks; the glossary defines CPOE, targeted air yards and YAC above expectation.
sources.limitation: Definitions verified; no player-level historical tracking dataset acquired.

sources.title: Official injury report
sources.finding: The retrieved page shows a 2026 week 8 injury report with practice and game status columns.
sources.limitation: Live page, not an archived pre-kickoff injury feed; no historical availability inference.

sources.title: NFL schedules
sources.finding: The schedule page exposes year and week navigation and game links.
sources.limitation: Not an immutable schedule archive; no result rows imported into a model.

sources.title: Player statistics
sources.finding: The page provides passing, rushing and receiving categories and year navigation.
sources.limitation: Fetched table lacks column headers in the text extraction. Numeric rows deliberately not imported.

sources.title: General rules · Virginia
sources.finding: The retrieved introduction explicitly identifies DraftKings Virginia house rules and a hierarchy of rules.
sources.limitation: Virginia-specific example, not universal rules or evidence of local eligibility. No odds feed obtained.

sources.title: Bet types and market rules
sources.finding: Whole-number two-way spreads and totals settle as Push when tied to the specified line.
sources.limitation: Only the cited market definitions were checked. Exact prop/SGP void and participation rules remain unverified.

sources.title: Cross-validation
sources.finding: Training and testing on the same data is a methodological mistake; a test set is held out for final evaluation.
sources.limitation: Official library documentation supports methodology, not evidence of NFL profitability.

sources.title: TimeSeriesSplit
sources.finding: Other CV methods can train on future data and evaluate on past data; comparable folds require equally spaced samples.
sources.limitation: NFL records require custom chronological game/week grouping; do not blindly split irregular rows.

sources.title: Probability calibration
sources.finding: Brier and log loss assess reliability, resolution and uncertainty; lower Brier alone does not prove better calibration.
sources.limitation: Reliability diagrams and held-out evaluation are also needed.

sources.title: Pearson correlation
sources.finding: Pearson measures linear relationship; constant input has undefined correlation; confidence intervals are available.
sources.limitation: Zero Pearson correlation does not establish independence; default parametric p-values need assumptions.

sources.title: Bootstrap confidence intervals
sources.finding: Resamples with replacement; paired=True resamples common indices across paired arrays.
sources.limitation: Game/week clustered resampling is a project adaptation, not a property of the default iid API.

sources.title: Multiple-testing corrections
sources.finding: Documents Holm, Benjamini/Hochberg and Benjamini/Yekutieli adjustments.
sources.limitation: Use Holm as the project default; neither adjustment repairs leakage or invalid p-values.

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted team strength
strategies.signal: Lagged team scoring and opponent strength; shrink early-season estimates.
strategies.model: Regularized home/away score distribution; price moneyline and spread from joint score samples.
strategies.risk: Roster drift, schedule strength and rule changes.

strategies.name: Possession & pace totals
strategies.signal: Lagged play volume and scoring efficiency, conditioned on game context.
strategies.model: Hierarchical possession and points model; retain discrete total and push probability.
strategies.risk: Pace may change with score; do not use realized game pace as a pregame feature.

strategies.name: Availability repricing
strategies.signal: Official injury updates available before the prediction cutoff.
strategies.model: Scenario-weighted lineup forecasts with explicit unknown-status uncertainty.
strategies.risk: Questionable is not a measured probability of absence; no automatic numeric conversion.

strategies.name: Receiver opportunity
strategies.signal: Lagged targets, intended air yards share and receiving opportunity.
strategies.model: Separate volume from efficiency; predict an integer reception distribution and yards distribution.
strategies.risk: Role changes, target competition and incomplete as-of data.

strategies.name: Rushing workload
strategies.signal: Lagged rushing volume, efficiency and box-count context.
strategies.model: Hierarchical workload model; scenario-based attempts and yards.
strategies.risk: Game-script dependence; rushing efficiency is not a standalone causal signal.

strategies.name: Cross-game value basket
strategies.signal: Individually qualified legs with synchronized executable prices.
strategies.model: Estimate joint win probability; multiply marginals only with justified independence.
strategies.risk: Common weather/regime exposure and offered parlay price can erase single-leg edge.

strategies.name: Quarterback × receiver
strategies.signal: Joint passing and receiving opportunities within the same game.
strategies.model: Shared game/drive simulation; count simulations where every leg wins.
strategies.risk: No fixed positive correlation assumption; pairwise correlation alone cannot price a combo.

strategies.name: Game-script combo
strategies.signal: Team score scenarios jointly with rushing or receiving workload.
strategies.model: Joint discrete outcomes; use actual quoted combo payout and exact settlement rules.
strategies.risk: Selection bias, unsupported correlation assumptions and operator repricing.

gates.name: Provenance & settlement
gates.rule: Every observation has an official URL, captured timestamp, stable event/player ID and applicable settlement version. Missing values block that market.

gates.name: As-of integrity
gates.rule: Features, injury updates and odds must be captured before prediction time; prediction before kickoff. Deduplicate records and keep each game in one fold.

gates.name: Preregistered walk-forward
gates.rule: Freeze candidate code, features, selection rule, folds and test family before the untouched holdout. Tune only inside chronological training windows.

gates.name: Predictive quality
gates.rule: Held-out Brier and log loss must beat preregistered naive and available no-vig market baselines; inspect reliability diagrams and subgroup uncertainty.

gates.name: Dependence & payout
gates.rule: Estimate held-out joint outcomes, sample size and game/week-clustered confidence intervals. No independence shortcut without evidence; quote exact combo price.

gates.name: Skill evidence
gates.rule: Positive lower bound of a preregistered 95% game/week-block bootstrap interval for net flat-stake return; Holm-adjusted p ≤ 0.05 across all tried candidates. Power analysis determines sample size, not an arbitrary bet count.

gates.name: Forward replication & risk
gates.rule: Freeze before prospective paper testing. Require a second nonoverlapping evaluation window, verified costs/limits, robustness checks and preregistered exposure/drawdown limits. No real-money deployment here.

markets.method: For no-push binary markets: fair decimal = 1 / p. For tie-as-push: fair decimal = (1 − p_push) / p_win.
markets.caution: Freeze the market’s tie and overtime treatment.

markets.output: Distribution of home score − away score
markets.method: For home handicap h, win if margin + h > 0; push if = 0. Fair decimal = (1 − p_push) / p_win.
markets.caution: Report a handicap and side price, not a mean margin alone.

markets.output: Distribution of home score + away score
markets.method: For over line t, win if total > t; push if = t. Fair decimal = (1 − p_push) / p_win.
markets.caution: Keep integer score mass and overtime rules.

markets.output: Player outcome distribution conditional on participation
markets.method: Evaluate probability at the exact threshold; retain equality mass when push is possible.
markets.caution: DNP, stat corrections and void rules not yet verified.

markets.method: For all-win/no-push only: fair decimal = 1 / P(all win). General EV = Σ P(state) × net return(state).
markets.caution: Actual quote required; pushes/voids can alter the payout.

flags.detail: No official, timestamped executable odds archive was obtained. No EV, closing-line value or ROI can be reported.
Official pages were inspected, but no complete game/player history with pregame feature snapshots was acquired. All candidate strategies remain untrained.
No matched held-out samples. All coefficients, sample sizes, joint hit rates and intervals are blank. Do not substitute intuitive signs.
Exact participation, void, overtime and stat-correction rules for each proposed prop/combo are not verified.
An attempted NFL Football Operations injury-policy URL returned only “Skip to main content”. No policy claims were taken from it; the official injury report was inspected instead.
No empirical gates have run. An attractive backtest alone would not remove luck; uncertainty, multiple testing and prospective replication remain necessary.
A paper competition policy is specified, but no sponsor, budget, prize amount or payment mechanism is verified. Reward amounts stay blank; no cash contest is running.
Retrieved operator general rules explicitly apply to Virginia. This is research only, not an eligibility determination or betting service for any location.
Source checks are dated snapshots of visible text, not a continuous feed. The extracted NFL player table omitted headers; numeric player rows were excluded rather than guessed.
Initial repository contained only README.md (# Own5); no preexisting datasets, algorithms or applications existed to audit. All new empirical fields remain blank.

competition.rule: All seven gates must pass with independent audit artifacts. Singles, parlays and prop combos are separate divisions. No candidate is currently eligible.
Within a division, rank eligible candidates by the lower 95% clustered net-return bound on the same preregistered evaluation window; tie-break with lower log loss, then lower drawdown.
Log all trials, including abandoned candidates; one frozen submission per strategy version. Apply Holm correction across the registered family. Deduplicate overlapping bets.
Proposed non-cash research badges: Evidence Leader (rank 1), Replicated (forward gate), Transparent (complete audit). Monetary rewards disabled until terms, sponsor and eligibility are verified.
Use flat 1-unit paper stakes for comparability, record all costs, pushes, voids and rejected quotes. Aggregate correlated exposure by game and week; compare with abstain and market baselines.
